title: Stalk of each homogeneous conormal piece
statement: For a closed immersion i, every n ≥ 0 and z ∈ Z, the module stalk of piece n [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra-basic] is additively isomorphic to K^n/K^(n+1), K=ker(i_z). Every representative germ maps to the quotient class of its ambient germ, with its canonical membership in K^n. This includes n=0.

source.place: Tag 0633; modules.tex, stalks of quotients and tensor pullback (Tags 01AG and 08KS).

proof.text: The image-power calculation gives stalk range K^n for the monic inclusion of I^n, including n=0. Its range equivalence transports the product stalk I·I^n to K·K^n=K^(n+1).

proof.text: Take quotients and compose the normalized unit quotient and the closed-pushforward stalk equivalence. Naturality of germs identifies every representative with its ambient quotient class.

theorem graded_piece_stalk (n : ℕ) (z : Z) :
    ∃ e : ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Z.toRingedSpace z).obj (piece i n)) ≃+
        Ideal.associatedGradedPiece (RingHom.ker (i.stalkMap z).hom) n,
      ∀ (U : X.Opens) (hz : i z ∈ U) (a : (power i n).val.obj (op U)),
        ∃ h : X.presheaf.germ U (i z) hz
            ((powerInclusion i n).val.app (op U) a) ∈
              RingHom.ker (i.stalkMap z).hom ^ n,
          e (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (piece i n).val.presheaf (i ⁻¹ᵁ U) z hz
            (representative i n U a)) = Submodule.Quotient.mk
              ⟨X.presheaf.germ U (i z) hz ((powerInclusion i n).val.app (op U) a), h⟩
